notes.title: Network Update – High Ping Control
notes.content:
To ensure a smoother and fairer experience for all players, we've implemented a new system to handle high ping situations more effectively.

✅ [b]What’s New:[/b]
[b]Extrapolation: Unlimited Enabled[/b]
Players with temporary packet loss or unstable connections will now continue moving smoothly, avoiding sudden freezes or teleporting. This helps maintain visual consistency even under mild lag.

[b]High Ping Detection System:[/b]
If a player’s ping exceeds 170ms for more than 5 seconds, they will be automatically removed from the match to maintain a stable multiplayer experience.

[b]On-Screen Warning Message:[/b]
Players with high ping will see a clear warning on screen, giving them a chance to stabilize their connection before being disconnected.

🎯 [b]Benefits:[/b]
- Greatly improves movement smoothness for players with moderate ping.
- Prevents laggy players from negatively affecting the match.
- Ensures a fair, consistent experience with no broken or delayed animations due to extreme latency.

tags.feature: Players with temporary packet loss or unstable connections will now continue moving smoothly, avoiding sudden freezes or teleporting. This helps maintain visual consistency even under mild lag.
If a player’s ping exceeds 170ms for more than 5 seconds, they will be automatically removed from the match to maintain a stable multiplayer experience.
Players with high ping will see a clear warning on screen, giving them a chance to stabilize their connection before being disconnected.

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
[b]🎨 Team Logo System Activated! [/b]

Upload your team logo (size: 512x512, transparent background) in discord

- When all players on the Red or Blue team use the same code, the team logo will be displayed above them in-game.

Obs: to put the code is in the visuals menu

[b]🧤 Goalkeeper Rebound System Added! ⚽[/b]

How it works:

- Hold Left Mouse Button (M1) while jumping left or right —
If the ball hits you, it will REBOUND with force and spin!

- Don’t hold M1, and just jump left or right —
The ball will not rebound if it hits you.

[b]📢 Other Features Added![/b]

- Added Match Stats
- Added team crest to player's chest, with uniform color automatically matching the crest. If all players on the same team (Red or Blue) share the same crest code, the customization is applied to the whole team.
- Added Header 

- Corner Kick Direction Bug Fixed
- Fixed goalkeeper issue where the ball would get stuck on the hand after a save — now it properly 
   falls down with gravity for more realistic behavior.
- Improved aerial ball control ( M1 CLICK )
- Fixed registration issue with spaces in usernames
- Resolved bug when sending team invites
- Fixed issue with wrong corner kick direction.
- Fixed bug where Red Kick and Blue Kick colors were not showing correctly.
- Fixed high ping spike when joining the game for the first time
- Fixed others bugs.
